subject: Deploy verification & secret-ageing evidence for SIG request
messages:
From: Doc Reviewer <docreviewer@sigassessor.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: acme.security@acmecorp.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: deploy verification & rotation evidence request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the phone sync earlier. As part of AcmeCorp's SIG assessment we need a concise package showing how Redwood ensures deploy integrity and secret hygiene for model-serving pipelines. Specifically we're asking for:

- Code-review proof for the last three production releases (PR IDs + approval logs).
- CI gate snapshot showing which checks blocked/unblocked the 2026-11-24 release.
- Secrets rotation logs (KMS/HSM or Vault) for the last 90 days.
- Policy statement or config that enforces secret maximum age (if applicable).
- Change approvals for runtime config / instance scaling that happened in November.
- A short summary describing how ephemeral credentials are issued to runners and how KV cache/state is protected.

Can you deliver a downloadable bundle by 2026-12-03 EOD PST? If any items are sensitive, a redacted bundle is fine; we just need traceability back to records.

Appreciate it — we can loop in Marissa for the pipeline artifacts and Jonas for runtime details.

Best,
Sam
Doc Reviewer, SIG Assessment
sigassessor.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Doc Reviewer <docreviewer@sigassessor.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:04:12 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: deploy verification & rotation evidence request

Thanks Sam — can do.

Marissa, Jonas, Rishi — I'm assigning owners below so we can assemble the bundle for Acme's SIG:

- Marissa Cole: pipeline snapshots, CI gate logs, and change approvals for November (MARISSA OWNER).
- Jonas Weber: code review provenance (PR lists, reviewer/approver audit trail, signed commits).
- Rishi Malhotra: secrets rotation logs, Vault/KMS audit trail, and a note on ephemeral credential issuance.

Target to stitch artifacts and a short readme by 2026-11-30 COB so I can run a quick quality pass and deliver the zip by 2026-12-01 morning. If any item requires a redaction step, mark it in the filename with "_REDACTED" and note the redaction in the manifest.

Sam — quick Q: do you need the raw pipeline tarball or is a flattened CSV + rotation JSON sufficient?

Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, docreviewer@sigassessor.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:33 -0800
Subject: CI/pipeline artifacts and rotation logs (draft bundle)

Hi all — attaching a draft bundle of artifacts for review. Attachment list (draft):
- pipeline-gate-snapshot-20261129.tar.gz (contains: pipeline run metadata, step logs, gate check results; suppressed secrets)
- rotation-log-2026-11-29.json (Vault rotation events for service accounts and runtime keys for last 90 days)
- policy-secret-ageing-90days.md (text excerpt from vault policy)

Summary of contents and provenance:
- CI gate snapshot: exported from our central CI archive. It includes the gate matrix (unit/integ/static-analysis/license-check) and the decision outcomes for the 2026-11-24 release (run id: ci-20261124-77). The gate is implemented as a merge-check job that requires 2 approvals + green build.
- Rotation log: produced by Vault's audit pipeline. Events have timestamps and actor IDs; we redacted long-lived token identifiers but preserved rotation event ids and request IDs for traceability. Latest rotation for runtime-key-ml-serving occurred 2026-11-15 (rotation id: rot-ml-20261115).
- Secret-ageing policy: set in Vault ACLs as max_secret_age_days: 90. For short-lived credentials we issue ephemeral tokens via the vault-approle flow with TTLs of 1 hour.

Notes / caveats:
- Code review artifacts are with Jonas — he will provide the PR list and a signed commit provenance manifest.
- Change approvals for infra autoscaling were recorded in the change log (Jira CHG-8821); I've included the approval timestamp and approver in the manifest.

If this looks OK, I'll package and run the redaction pass tonight and produce a single zip.

Attachments: pipeline-gate-snapshot-20261129.tar.gz, rotation-log-2026-11-29.json, policy-secret-ageing-90days.md

Marissa Cole
Senior DevOps Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Doc Reviewer <docreviewer@sigassessor.com>, acme.security@acmecorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Deliverable: deploy verification & secret-ageing evidence (SIG)

Sam / Acme security —

Attached is the compiled evidence bundle for the deploy integrity and secret-ageing request: sig-evidence-deploy-verification-20261130.zip (link below). The package includes:

- PR-provenance.csv (Jonas Weber): list of PRs for the last three releases, reviewers, approvals, and signed commit SHAs.
- pipeline-gate-snapshot-20261129.tar.gz (Marissa Cole): gate matrix and step logs (sensitive tokens suppressed).
- rotation-log-2026-11-29.json (Marissa Cole): Vault rotation events for the last 90 days with rotation ids preserved.
- policy-secret-ageing-90days.md (Marissa Cole / Rishi Malhotra): excerpt of vault policy and enforcement note.
- change-approvals-manifest.csv (Marissa Cole): November change approvals (Jira refs).
- readme.txt: mapping of each artifact to the request items + redaction notes.

Links / download: https://drive.redwood.com/Acme/SIG/sig-evidence-deploy-verification-20261130.zip
HubSpot record: HS-84721 (for tracking delivery).

Short operational notes:
- Secret-ageing enforcement: Vault policy enforces max_secret_age_days=90 for persistent credentials; runtime credentials are ephemeral via AppRole and have TTLs typically set at 1 hour.
- Access controls: all rotation requests require an operator action recorded in Vault audit; KMS keys used for encryption are access-controlled and limited to platform-ops and key-rotation automation role.
- Traceability: every rotation event includes a rotation-id and request-id which map back to our change log and CI run ids.

If you need a live walkthrough of any artifact or additional redaction, ping me and we can schedule a 30-minute session.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Delivered attachments: sig-evidence-deploy-verification-20261130.zip (contains the files listed above).
